name.zh: 第11屆CPTPP執委會（部長級）會議

next_meeting.note: Viet Nam (2026 chair) says the 11th Commission meeting is in Nov 2026 in Viet Nam; a CPTPP-ASEAN-EU business forum in Hanoi on 26 Nov 2026 is billed as on its sidelines. Exact Commission dates not officially published.

title.zh: 哥斯大黎加完成入會談判

summary.en: In May 2026 CPTPP parties concluded the work of Costa Rica's accession working group, making it the next country in line to join.
summary.zh: 2026年5月，CPTPP成員完成哥斯大黎加入會工作小組的談判，哥國成為下一個準備加入的國家。

question.en: Why would a small economy like Costa Rica want to join a mostly Asia-Pacific trade deal?
question.zh: 像哥斯大黎加這樣的小型經濟體，為什麼想加入以亞太為主的貿易協定？

title.en: Preparatory talks with UAE, Indonesia, Philippines
title.zh: 與阿聯、印尼、菲律賓展開入會預備討論

summary.en: At the online Commission meeting on 26 June 2026, ministers agreed to start preparatory discussions with the UAE, Indonesia and the Philippines and created a working group on rules of origin and illegal transshipment.
summary.zh: 2026年6月26日線上執委會會議中，部長們同意與阿聯、印尼、菲律賓展開入會預備討論，並成立處理原產地規則與非法轉運的工作小組。

question.en: How might rules against transshipment change where companies build factories in Asia?
question.zh: 防止轉運的規則，可能如何影響企業在亞洲設廠的選擇？

summary.en: As 2026 chair, Viet Nam is pushing expansion, an upgrade of the agreement and trade dialogues with ASEAN and the EU.
summary.zh: 越南作為2026年主席國，推動擴大成員、協定升級，以及與東協和歐盟的貿易對話。

question.en: What can a developing economy gain from chairing a high-standard trade agreement?
question.zh: 開發中經濟體擔任高標準貿易協定的主席國，可以獲得什麼？

text.en: Original TPP signed by 12 countries including the US
text.zh: 包含美國在內的12國簽署原始TPP

text.en: 11 countries sign CPTPP (March); in force 30 December
UK, China and Taiwan apply to join
text.zh: 英國、中國與台灣申請加入

text.en: CPTPP enters into force for the UK (12th party)
text.zh: CPTPP對英國生效（第12個締約方）

text.en: Costa Rica talks concluded; Viet Nam chairs
text.zh: 哥斯大黎加談判完成；越南任主席國
